alex-sales: Heads up 1: Prospect HelixBank asked for a 10-day POC next week. Scope: SSO via Okta (SP-initiated and IdP metadata), SCIM for user + group sync (delta + bulk), RBAC mapping, and domain verification for three subdomains. They also attached a security questionnaire. Need answers on SCIM rate limits, domain claim process, Dedicated POC pricing, and what items we can drop into the security packet. @marta-se @dan-eng

marta-se: Got it. Quick answers: SAML we support SP-initiated and can consume IdP metadata XML/URL. SCIM 2.0 supported: bulk import endpoint for initial seeding + PATCH delta for updates. Group -> role mapping supported; you can configure an allowlist of groups that are allowed to provision roles.

dan-eng: SCIM detail: delta operations are PATCH-style; delta feed only includes changed resources. For the POC we usually: 1) call bulk import to seed ~1000 users, 2) enable delta for live updates. Default hosted SCIM throttle is 60 req/s; Dedicated customers can request higher limits for the window. If they plan a single big migration, recommend bulk with pagination. Example PATCH we accept: {"schemas":["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"],"Operations":[{"op":"replace","path":"active","value":true},{"op":"replace","path":"groups","value":[{"value":"sales","display":"Sales"}]}]}

marta-se: Note re: groups in SAML assertions 1: large or nested group claims can exceed assertion size or be flattened by Okta. SCIM group sync avoids that.

kevin-ops: Domain verification: we generate a TXT token per domain. Customer must add DNS TXT for each subdomain. If they control the parent zone and want a single TXT to cover many subdomains we can offer an ops-approved shortcut, but no wildcard verification for apex domains. Verification typically completes within minutes of propagation; allow 24 hours as a safe window. We can run the verification script for them if they provide DNS access temporarily.

alex-sales: Pricing ask: HelixBank expects moderate traffic ~200k tokens/day during POC with bursts. What are options?

kevin-ops: Two paths: Hosted elevated-quotas + credits (fast) or a short Dedicated trial. For Dedicated POC we can do a 10-day trial billed at a daily flat rate or convert to a short reserved commit for sustained throughput. Rough estimate for their numbers: $3k/week for Dedicated trial (includes larger SCIM throttle). I'll get a formal quote from sales ops. :money_with_wings:

tina-legal: Security packet checklist: SOC2 Type II summary, encryption-at-rest doc, KMS integration note, network isolation whitepaper (for Dedicated), pen-test summary, SAML metadata endpoints, SCIM scope and retention policy, and data residency statements. If they return their completed questionnaire, we'll answer and escalate any legal/IP/processing clauses. If they ask for an ISA or DPA redline, that's a separate legal follow-up.

alex-sales: Cool. Practical questions: can delegated tenant admins manage domain claims and SCIM settings? HelixBank wants a delegated admin role.

marta-se: Yes 1. For Dedicated/Private we expose tenant-scoped admin roles that can manage SSO, SCIM toggles, and domain claims. For Hosted we offer tenant admin too but with limited actions (we handle final verification if they prefer). We also support locking which groups can be synced via allowlists.

dan-eng: Ops caveat: if Okta sends very large SAML attributes (e.g., 10k group entries) it could cause issues; recommend SCIM for group-heavy orgs. Also watch SCIM paging sizes during bulk import to avoid timeouts.

calendar-bot: Created event "HelixBank POC kickoff 1: SSO & SCIM" Thu 9:30AM (45m) with #sales, @marta-se, @dan-eng, @tina-legal.

alex-sales: Nice. I'll send them a short checklist asking for: IdP metadata (XML or URL), SCIM token and test user if possible, list of domains, and their filled security questionnaire. I'll follow up with the formal quote by EOD. :thumbsup:
